source_description: Paul Zianno (center), chief of civil works for acquisition and management for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Sacramento District Isabella Lake Dam Safety Modification Project, discusses impacted properties and proposed real estate actions with local residents at a public meeting March 27, 2014 in Lake Isabella, Calif. ... (U.S. Army photo by John Prettyman/Released)
caption: Paul Zianno, chief of civil works acquisition and management for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Sacramento District, explains the Isabella Lake Dam safety project's land purchases to residents at a public meeting in Lake Isabella, California, March 27, 2014. Photograph: John Prettyman, U.S. Army.
why_it_fits: People doing public work, an official among them: a named federal official answers residents' questions at a public meeting, beside the project map and a board headed "Steps in the real estate process". Who, what, where and when are all in the agency caption.
notes: The Commons description carries a stray phrase, "Cross border estate planning", that is not part of the agency caption; leave it out. The residents are seen from behind and are not named.
